tax.text:
We utilize the asset and liability method of accounting for income taxes. Valuation allowances are established when necessary to reduce deferred tax assets to the amounts expected to be realized.

The calculation of our tax liabilities involves dealing with uncertainties in applying tax laws and regulations in numerous jurisdictions. Tax benefits from uncertain tax positions are recognized when it is more likely than not that the positions will be sustained upon examination, including resolutions of any related appeals or litigation processes, based on the technical merits. lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Goodwill
lines.why: Paid for acquired businesses: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Equity-method investments
lines.why: Stakes in associated businesses, usually part of operations. Financial if held as an investment.

lines.name: Deferred tax assets
lines.why: Taxes on operating income paid ahead: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current assets
lines.why: Other long-term operating items: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue
lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.

lines.name: Income taxes payable
lines.why: Taxes on operating income: operating.

lines.name: Long-term debt
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue, non-current
lines.why: Customers' payments for later years: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities
lines.why: Other long-term operating obligations: operating.

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

s.t: Approximately 90% of ClearanceJobs revenue was derived from recruitment packages in 2025.
Approximately 90% of Dice revenue was derived from recruitment packages in 2025.
No one customer accounted for more than 10% of our revenues in 2025.

ClearanceJobs had 1,775 recruitment package customers as of December 31, 2025 compared to 1,949 as of December 31, 2024, a 9% decrease, and average revenue per recruitment package customer increased 9%.

Dice had 4,132 recruitment package customers as of December 31, 2025, which was a decrease of 579 , or 12%, and average annual revenue per recruitment package customer for Dice decreased 3% for the year ended December 31, 2025.

No single customer represents 10% or more of accounts receivable as of December 31, 2025 and 2024 and no single customer represents 10% or more of revenues for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023.

Our growth depends on our ability to retain our existing recruitment package customers and to increase the number of customers who purchase recruitment packages, as well as introduce new pricing options.
As a result, our operations depend on our ability to maintain and protect our website services, most of which are housed within AWS.
We rely on the services of third-party data center hosting facilities.
Our business depends on our ability to collect, store, use, and disclose personal and professional data from the professionals who use our websites.
We also rely on laws, including those regarding copyrights and trademarks to protect our intellectual property rights.

The primary sources of temporary differences are amortization and impairment of intangible assets, depreciation of fixed assets, operating lease assets and liabilities, and capitalized contract costs.
